name: Armor Of God
overview: Scripture presents the Armor of God as essential spiritual protection for believers engaged in a battle not against flesh and blood but against spiritual forces of evil (Ephesians 6:11-12). This armor includes righteousness as a breastplate and salvation as a helmet, reflecting the example of God Himself who clothed Himself in these virtues (Isaiah 59:17; Ephesians 6:14). Believers are called to stand firm by being strengthened in the Lord's power, prepared with the gospel of peace, and fully equipped with truth and righteousness to withstand the devil's schemes (Ephesians 6:10, 15).
